• We may be unable to purchase third-party reinsurance or otherwise expand our catastrophe coverage in amounts we desire or on terms that are commercially acceptable and adequately protect us, including due to volatility in reinsurance market conditions, and this inability may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations;
